params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items returned per page. Verified server cap is 100; a larger value returns HTTP 400 rest_invalid_param.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a free-text string.

params.name: orderby
params.description: Field to sort the collection by.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines the fields present in the response. Anonymous callers may use `view` and `embed` only - `edit` returns HTTP 401.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit results to items with one of the given slugs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Comma-separated list of fields to limit the response to (e.g. `id,slug,title,link`). A WordPress core response-shaping convention, verified working on this host.

params.name: media_type
params.description: Limit results to attachments of a specific media type.

params.name: mime_type
params.description: Limit results to attachments of a specific MIME type.

params.name: parent
params.description: Limit results to attachments of the given parent object IDs.
